name: convergent-beam-without-fractal-deals-one-damage
notes: Convergent Beam with no Fractal object: 1 damage.

rulesClauses: Deal 1 damage to target unit. If you control a Fractal object, deal 3 damage to that unit instead.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Convergent Beam computed $controlsFractal in the activation body and read it (undefined) in the separate resolution handler, so the 3-damage Fractal branch could never apply. The resolution handler is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php and checks for a Fractal object when the damage is dealt.
